overall_assessment: All 20 packet courses were read in full (14 suspects and 6 random controls); most top-level boundaries and all visible knowledge/skills/competence groups survive. Real defects include mixed canonical content, three courses with misplaced coursework, lost or misplaced subject prerequisites and exam-language instructions, pointer-only reading rows, and recurring administrative/language/exam noise confirmed by controls. Short teaching flags and LER-3101’s teaching leak are false alarms, reading empty/boilerplate flags and ODO-6302’s coursework leak are real, ARK-3021’s short outcome row is misclassified metadata, and ODO’s reading leak cannot be verified in the packet-capped excerpt.

findings.evidence: Kandidaten skal ha følgende kliniske ferdigheter:
findings.description: Mixed source fields are retained wholesale instead of split by canonical meaning. ODO-6302 files extensive knowledge and clinical-skill outcomes under course_content; END-3602 keeps the explicit student-capability list beginning In detail, the students will there too. BIO-3515 keeps the cruise, lecture/seminar hours and report activity in course_content rather than teaching_methods. HIS-1007 likewise leaves substantive reading-list notation in course_content. These are semantic boundary errors, not losses caused by packet truncation. ODO’s leak->reading_list flag cannot be independently confirmed in the capped excerpt, so no missing reading list is inferred.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: sectionize() assigns text by its parent heading. UiT reads h2/.fsemneoverskrift and h3/strong.d-block, but the visible in-text discipline/outcome labels and mixed prose receive no additional semantic splitting.
findings.suggested_fix: Add bounded UiT inline rules for Kunnskap i <discipline>, Kliniske ferdigheter i <discipline> and In detail, the students will, routing their outcome lists to learning_outcomes while preserving discipline context. Separate explicit teaching-arrangement passages and reading-notation sentences from topic prose; stop at the next relevant label.

findings.evidence: Følgende arbeidskrav må være oppfylt for at spesialistkandidaten skal få ta slutteksamen:
findings.description: Exam-gating work is misclassified in three plans. ODO-6302’s learning_outcomes row consists entirely of arbeidskrav and no coursework_requirements row exists, confirming leak->coursework_requirements. BED-6001 leaves all approved intermediate assignments and their access condition in assessment. HEL-3050 moves the written arbeidskrav correctly but leaves compulsory attendance in teaching_methods. Conversely, GEO-2007, BED-2017, HIS-1007, BNS-1006, LRU-3909 and the modern Norwegian exam tables demonstrate successful separation. LER-3101’s leak->teaching_methods flag is a false alarm: its Undervisningsopplegg is an approved compulsory task.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: .split_inline_coursework() only processes assessment. It cannot repair arbeidskrav under learning_outcomes or compulsory attendance under teaching_methods; BED-6001’s unlabelled intermediate-assignment description also escapes the assessment gate patterns.
findings.suggested_fix: Extend the UiT gate pass to bounded Arbeidskrav blocks under learning_outcomes and explicit compulsory-attendance sentences under teaching_methods. In assessment, link the BED-6001 intermediate-assignment description to its explicit approval-before-project-assessment condition and move the complete ungraded requirement, preserving the graded project description.

findings.evidence: Det forutsettes grunnleggende kunnskaper i kjemi, biokjemi og mikrobiologi.
findings.description: RUS-3950 retains the entire recommended EXF720 prior-knowledge passage in teaching_methods and emits no prerequisites row. BIO-3607 extracts the named prerequisite courses but leaves the additional assumed chemistry, biochemistry and microbiology knowledge in course_content. These passages belong in prerequisites regardless of their source heading.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: .split_inline_prerequisites() only examines course_content and requires a recognized label. It cannot handle teaching_methods, the source spelling Anbefalte forkunn-skaper, or an unlabelled Det forutsettes sentence.
findings.suggested_fix: Normalize forkunn-skaper for label matching and scan teaching_methods for the bounded Anbefalte forkunn-skaper passage, stopping before Arbeidet med masteroppgaven. Move explicit Det forutsettes ... kunnskaper sentences from course_content to prerequisites, appending to existing prior-course requirements.

findings.evidence: For studenter som tar emnet som videreutdanning er forkunnskapskravet fullført lærerutdanning med minimum 60 studiepoeng i norsk.
findings.description: The full plan specifies a completed teacher qualification with at least 60 credits in Norwegian, but no prerequisites row is emitted. This is substantive prior subject education. Removing the separate Jf. opptakskrav og progresjonskrav pointer is appropriate because that pointer supplies no actual prior-knowledge requirement.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/section_heading_map.R maps Opptakskrav to .drop; .clean_sections() discards the entire block, including its explicit subject qualification.
findings.suggested_fix: Before discarding UiT Opptakskrav blocks, retain sentences explicitly stating forkunnskapskravet with completed subject qualifications or subject credits in prerequisites. Continue excluding admission procedures, programme eligibility and bare pointers.

findings.evidence: A relevant undergraduate Bachelor Engineering program with minimum 25 credits mathematics, 5 credits statistics, 7,5 credits physics
findings.description: The prerequisites row retains only two recommended END courses and omits the stated minimum prior mathematics, statistics and physics credits. The mixed qualification sentence should remain whole under the specification; the institution’s Admission requirements heading does not make the academic credit requirements administrative boilerplate.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Admission requirements is an unmapped top-level heading. sectionize() closes the preceding section and drops its text; the later Prerequisites block recovers only the recommended courses.
findings.suggested_fix: Read UiT English Admission requirements blocks for explicit academic qualifications and subject-credit requirements and append those sentences to prerequisites before discarding application codes and admission-only instructions.

findings.evidence: Eksamensoppgavene gis på engelsk, mens besvarelsene må være på engelsk eller norsk/skandinavisk.
findings.description: Explicit exam-question and permitted answer languages are present in the plan, but no assessment row is emitted. course_plan_spec.md includes exam language in assessment design. No missing assessment form is alleged: the source supplies no form.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The combined Undervisnings- og eksamensspråk heading maps to .drop, removing substantive exam-language instructions along with language metadata.
findings.suggested_fix: Before dropping combined instruction/exam-language blocks, retain explicit sentences about exam-question and answer languages in assessment with their source context; allow these sentences to create an assessment row even when no assessment-form field exists.

findings.evidence: Oppgaven kan skrives enten på engelsk eller norsk/skandinavisk.
findings.description: The project-assessment row omits the explicit permitted submission languages present under the combined instruction/exam-language heading. This is partial loss of assessment design, rather than a missing section as in BIO-8806.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The .drop mapping for Undervisnings- og eksamensspråk discards the submission-language rule instead of appending it to the existing assessment section.
findings.suggested_fix: Retain the exact Oppgaven kan skrives ... sentence from the combined language field and append it to assessment before dropping metadata-only text; share the field handling with the BIO-8806 missing-assessment fix.

findings.description: Fifteen of twenty courses emit reading_list rows containing only pointers or contact notes: all twelve 2008 plans, plus LER-3101, FHO9043 and BED-2109. The old rows contain Se hjemmeside, the quoted contact note, Available on request, or a project-availability contact note; the three modern rows contain only the Leganto access notice and Pensumliste for link label. These empty/boilerplate flags are real under course_plan_spec.md’s pointer-only exclusion. LRU-3909’s self-selected-literature policy is substantive and should remain. Short teaching-method statements accurately reproduce the source and are not empty placeholders.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: .placeholder_phrases lacks these UiT homepage/contact/on-request variants and the two-line Leganto notice plus course-specific link label.
findings.suggested_fix: Add reading-list-specific whole-row patterns for these pointer/contact variants, including the complete Leganto access-note plus Pensumliste for <course> combination. Drop only rows composed entirely of pointer/contact material, preserving real references and substantive literature policies.

findings.evidence:
Language of instruction and examination
English
findings.description: All three modern English controls append the combined language metadata heading and value to teaching_methods. END-3602 also retains an inline Teaching and Examination Language sentence. The Norwegian combined language subheading is separated correctly, showing an English handling gap.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: heading_pattern() returns unmapped for language of instruction via its denylist. sectionize() restores the parent teaching_methods section at an unmapped subheading and retains the label and value.
findings.suggested_fix: Add explicit handling for the exact English combined language subheading before the denylist and remove its metadata-only label/value from teaching_methods. Apply the same handling to the inline END-3602 field; preserve substantive exam-answer-language instructions in assessment.

findings.evidence: Everything you need to know about before, during, and after the exam; registration, absence, appeals, and diplomas: UiT Exams homepage
findings.description: The generic exam-portal link sentence pollutes coursework_requirements in BIO-3529 and assessment in END-3602. It provides navigation and administrative guidance, not section content. Exam-table form, duration and grading values are valid assessment design and are not defects.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: UiT’s page exclusion matches the Norwegian exam URL/prefix, while the English portal sentence survives; .section_noise also lacks its English counterpart.
findings.suggested_fix: Extend UiT’s exam-link exclusion or section cleanup to remove the complete English portal sentence from assessment and coursework_requirements, retaining adjacent exam-design table cells and course-specific requirements.

findings.evidence:
Re-sit examination
There will be a re-sit examination for students that did not pass the previous ordinary examination.
findings.description: Ten courses retain resit, appeal, examiner-arrangement or exam-system logistics in assessment: ARK-3021, HIS-1007, ODO-6302, FYS-3730, HEL-3050 and five controls (BIO-3529, END-3602, LRU-3909, BNS-1006, FHO9043). The specification expressly excludes these from sections. Standalone Norwegian Kontinuasjonseksamen subheadings are dropped correctly in LER-3101 and BED-2109; inline rules, English headings and spelling variants remain.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The generic examination pattern maps Re-sit examination to assessment. Exact Norwegian logistics mappings do not catch inline text or the soft-hyphen variant in FHO9043, and UiT has no corresponding sentence/block cleanup.
findings.suggested_fix: Map the exact Re-sit examination heading to .drop and normalize soft hyphens in labels. Add bounded UiT cleanup for inline resit/appeal, examiner-arrangement and exam-platform sentences, preserving assessment form, components, weights, duration, language and grading.

findings.evidence: Valgfritt masteremne. Kan blant annet brukes som støtteemne i historie og religionsvitenskap
findings.description: Non-section plan metadata survives within mapped fields in ten courses, including all six controls. ARK-3021’s learning_outcomes row contains only the quoted programme-role statement, making its short flag a real misclassification. Eight modern plans retain programme reservation/enkeltemne preambles in course_content. LER-3101, LRU-3909 and BNS-1006 retain course-evaluation notices in teaching_methods; BIO-3529 retains total workload, and BED-6001 retains dated session schedules. These are outside the seven canonical sections. The genuine visible knowledge/skills/competence outcome groups remain intact.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: sectionize() trusts mapped parent blocks. Admission filtering only runs on prerequisites, and UiT lacks filters for programme-role preambles, evaluation, total workload and dated schedules. LER-3101’s Kvalitetssikring label is absent from the read-heading list, so its paragraph remains teaching text.
findings.suggested_fix: Add narrowly bounded UiT cleanup for programme reservation/enkeltemne/support-subject declarations, explicit course-evaluation notices, total-workload statements and dated session listings. Recognize plain-text Kvalitetssikring blocks. Preserve topic prose, genuine outcomes, teaching activities and session format/duration; suppress rows left with only excluded metadata.
